summary: Verified customer first_name/last_name schema end-to-end: backend CRUD name<->first/last coherence, portal register/verify/login + PATCH /portal/me mirror to customers, and email greeting first-name helper. Frontend UI: separate First/Last inputs on Create Customer + Customer Detail Profile confirmed, combined name renders in list rows and detail header. 6/6 backend pytest cases pass; frontend flow (create -> list -> detail -> edit -> save -> header update) confirmed via Playwright with observed POST/PATCH 200 responses.

issues: Console hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> — not caused by this feature but observed on every page load. Consider fixing in the select rendering upstream.

verified_behaviors: POST /api/customers with {first_name,last_name,name:''} -> composes name 'First Last' and persists first_name/last_name.
POST /api/customers with only {name:'Grace Hopper'} -> auto-splits to first_name='Grace', last_name='Hopper'.
PATCH /api/customers/{id} with {name:'Ada Byron King'} -> resyncs first_name='Ada', last_name='Byron King'; PATCH with {first_name,last_name} recomposes name.

Portal full flow: order create -> POST /api/portal/register (activation_link returned, email not configured) -> POST /api/portal/verify -> POST /api/portal/login -> GET /api/portal/me shows first/last (split from register name). PATCH /api/portal/me with {first_name,last_name} updates account and mirrors into customers row (verified via GET /api/customers). PATCH /api/portal/me with only {name:'Some Full Name'} splits correctly.

helpers._greeting_first_name uses explicit first_name when present, else first token of customer_name; empty -> 'there'. send_customer_order_confirmation composes 'Hi <FirstName>,' via this helper (code path confirmed).

Frontend Create Customer form exposes data-testid='cus-first-name' and 'cus-last-name'; successful POST /api/customers observed; new row appears in All Customers with combined name (via custName helper).

Frontend Customer Detail Profile exposes data-testid='customer-first-name-input' and 'customer-last-name-input'; edited to 'EditFirst'/'EditLast', Save triggers PATCH /api/customers/{id} 200, and header re-renders to 'EditFirst EditLast'.
critical_code_review_comments: PortalRegisterBody (models.py) does NOT accept first_name/last_name — only `name`. Server-side portal_register splits `name` into first/last, so this works, but if PCStore ever submits first/last during registration they would be silently ignored. Consider adding optional first_name/last_name to PortalRegisterBody for symmetry with PortalProfileUpdate.
Persistent hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears on all screens (Layout component). Not blocking, but should be cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Test-created customers (TEST_fl_* and one UI-created 'AliceQA uifl78618') were deleted at the end of each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_customer_first_last_name.py can be re-run. Portal register accepts only {email,password,name}, not first/last — encoded that assumption in the test. Products list endpoint response wrapper: unwrap items/products or raw list. Order creation uses OrderCreate schema {product_id, quantity, ...} — not items[].
